carry_forward_constraints: S41 must not treat S40 architecture/DDD gates as passed. S40 is REPAIR_REQUIRED with 41 findings and S39/CF-3 debt remains active.

S41 API contracts must bind every endpoint/job/evidence response to immutable architecture and N3 artifact IDs/versions/hashes; a clean FastAPI schema cannot launder stale ER, graph, feature, model or policy artifacts.

Declare the public API and explicit compatibility/extensibility policy before using SemVer or calling a change backward compatible. State how unknown response fields, required fields, enums, errors, ordering and pagination evolve.
Run old-consumer contract tests against candidate API versions. A single dict where v1 fields remain unchanged is not contract evidence.
Preserve no-autofraud, abstention and human-review destination as executable API policy. No endpoint may turn ER/graph/model score into fraud, guilt, relationship or automatic adverse action.

Keep observed evidence, graph-path evidence, model features/contributions, uncertainty and human decisions distinct in schemas; preserve evidence_id, source/run/snapshot/version and as-of lineage across API boundaries.
Bounded contexts may share vocabulary. S41 schemas must implement explicit translations/ACL semantics, not assume contexts are valid because field-name tokens are disjoint.
Ownership is auditable metadata: endpoints, policies, schemas and deprecations need synthetic owner_id/escalation references rather than free-form team strings.

Human decision/override/appeal remain separate durable workflows with actor/reason/timestamp/prior-decision/artifact-policy versions; API convenience fields must not collapse them into one mutable status.
Feedback labels carry source/time/training eligibility so API persistence cannot introduce temporal leakage or self-training feedback loops.
Threshold, calibrator, feature/reference and policy versions remain separate artifacts with compatibility checks. Do not hide them inside a model_version string.
API quality attributes must reference real finite/nonnegative BenchmarkResult evidence; reject bool/negative/NaN/inf latency or rate inputs and do not hand-write p95 as proof.
S41 dependency/port boundaries must be tested with executable contract suites. port_ok=True, Protocol shape alone or a two-edge blacklist are not architecture evidence.

If S41 exposes asynchronous jobs/events, event schema/version, idempotency identity, retry semantics and error/dead-letter behavior must be explicit and compatible with S38 durable recovery requirements.
Deprecation/technical debt must include affected consumers, support status, migration path, owner and removal condition/date; retire_on alone is insufficient.

Carry pytest systematically: include S40 regressions for empty QA owner/text, invalid/nonfinite timings, NaN/duplicate trade-offs, empty/unknown/cyclic dependency graphs, disjoint-vocabulary false rejection, invalid score weights, names-only C4/ADR and payload-only compatibility.
Do not use S40's current Theory playground as evidence: it is an off-topic multi-agent simulation explicitly excluded by S40 scope.
Do not cite S40-layer-imports as a rendered teaching artifact until it is registered; move architecture figures adjacent to their matching concepts to reduce split attention.
S41 must not architect or schema away unresolved S27-S40 defects. Phase 3 APIs expose contracts; they do not retroactively validate broken evaluation, fairness, resilience or CF-3 evidence.
